reason: Jacob Franciscus is a normal variant of Jacobus Francois. The owner is in Graaff-Reinet, which matches the declared district, and no other candidate shares both names.
Martinus is a spelling variant of Marthinus. The owner is the only Oosthuizen candidate and is in Uitenhage, the declared district.
C01 is a widow and C02 is Martinus Jacobus. Neither matches Johannes Hendrik.
C04 Willem is a deceased estate, so it cannot be this man. C05 Bartolomeus Jacobus has Jacobus rather than Willem, and the others have entirely different given names.
Johannes Janse van Vuuren is an exact name match, and the owner is in George, the declared district.
No Pretorius owner is named Sybrand. The only overlap is Gerhardus as a second name, as in Petrus Gerhardus and Roelof Gerhardus Petrus, which is not enough.
No owner is named Johannes Stephanus. C01 and C08 are recorded as sons of SJ, so they cannot be SJ himself, and C06 is Hercules Stephanus.
The only candidate is Johannes Hermanus, son of N., which is clearly a different given name from Pieter.
Thomas Arnoldus du Toit is an exact name match. The owner is in Graaff-Reinet, which included the area later called Colesberg.
Petrus Arnoldus Pienaar is an exact name match. The owner is in Graaff-Reinet, which covered Colesberg, and since the genealogy gives no father, the 'sv JJ' note does not conflict.
